title.narrative: Climate Proofing Building Sector CSOs for the Green Deal

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to enhance capacities of civil society stakeholders on the EU Green Deal for increased awareness, integrated approach, and stronger compliance.

The specific objectives are:

  1. Enhancing technical capacities of CSOs and their members towards mitigation and adaptation methods, measures and strategies on constructing and renovating in an energy and resource efficient way for resilient and climate-proof buildings as addressed in EU Green Deal and also improving dialogue and cooperation between civil society, private and public stakeholders (ie. local governments) which build up building sector ecosystem in Türkiye (including CSOs, associations and unions representing building material producers, contractors, real estate developers, clean energy suppliers; green building councils; property management unions; chambers of architects and engineers; owners, etc.) for knowledge & experience sharing and integrated action towards climate proof buildings in compliance with the EU Green Deal.
  2. Stimulating behavioural, social and cultural change by enhancing the understanding and awareness of the relevant stakeholders towards the importance and the impact of the EU Green Deal and creating a better understanding of the EU Green Deal on new buildings and renovations in order to inspire stakeholders to implement similar actions.

The project was awarded under the call for proposal that aims to support the improvement of the capacities of civil society organisations towards the achievement of the ambitious targets of the European Green Deal.
